title: Sandria VN sources 2026: which websites four AI assistants cited for everyday questions about Vietnam, in English and Vietnamese
description:
A dated record of the websites four AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini, through their developer APIs with web search available) cited when asked 24 everyday questions about businesses and services in Vietnam, in English and in Vietnamese, each twice, on 2026-10-15. 384 answers, 1,544 citations across 613 websites, each classified by type and by whether it is based in Vietnam, plus the question set, the six pre-registered numbers and the pre-registration with its amendments. Answer texts, URLs and page titles are withheld. Every business's own website is coded as an identifier and the mapping is not published. This is not a ranking of any business or website, and no cited website is verified as true. See LIMITATIONS.md before use.

Measured by Sandria™. Finding and method: https://sandria.ai/findings/language-changes-ai-sources/
notes: Publisher and rights holder: Sandria OÜ, registry code 17585074. Corrections: hello@sandria.ai.
